text:
alex: kicking off a docs PR that overhauls the quotas & metering pages. includes: per-route examples, migration notes (per-minute -> per-second), SDK snippets for reading rate-limit headers, and a short FAQ about throttling vs overage billing. would love quick eyeballs.

maria: thanks alex. tagging @devlin for the SDK bits and @kevin for the actual numbers. please avoid publishing any final pricing until finance confirms. i'll also comb for ambiguous 'requests' language and swap to 'metering units (tokens)'.

devlin: on it. i'll add concise Python, JS, and curl examples showing how to detect and react to X-RateLimit headers, plus a small client-side backoff snippet. plan to include: header parsing, exponential backoff, and how to surface Retry-After.

alex: great. i left a stub showing the console's new "per-route" widget and a placeholder link to the preview. also added a callout about metric freshness (approx 2 minute lag) since support gets tickets about that.

sam: for the migration guide, i drafted a short checklist: export current usage, re-evaluate burst needs, and update server-side rate-limit logic. emphasized the behavioral change: per-second quotas are finer-grained and may surface more 429s unless clients smooth traffic. added a short FAQ entry.

kevin: finance hasn't locked numbers yet. please mark all tier prices as TBC. i'll coordinate with finance and post final numbers by EOD tomorrow.

maria: fixed two internal links that pointed to archived grafana dashboards; updated to console paths and left redirects in place. also tightened wording in the "enforcement" section to clearly separate soft throttles (429 + Retry-After) and hard caps (billing-block).

devlin: pushed commit with snippets. example highlights: reading headers in Python and adding Retry-After-aware retry. short sample: ```python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
headers = resp.meta.get('headers', {})
limit = headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit')
reset = headers.get('X-RateLimit-Reset')
```

alex: added a tiny note showing how to request detailed usage headers from the API so customers can collect per-route metrics: 
```bash
curl -H "X-RW-Usage-Detail: full" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

kevin: also a reminder — screenshots for the dashboard should include a small caption about the sampling window (1m vs 1s) and that billing uses token counts rounded to the billing unit. otherwise confusion.

sam: adjusted the migration wording to recommend a canary period and to monitor moving 95th/99th percentile latencies. added a note for support to prepare a short explainer.

maria: docs-bot flagged an image with no alt text in the quotas table — i added alt text and reduced copy density on the table. docs-bot now reports only minor warnings.

devlin: added JS retry snippet too: ```js
async function generateWithBackoff(prompt){
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    try{ return await client.generate({prompt}); } catch(e){
      if(e.status===429){ await sleep(Math.min(2000 * 2**i, 30000)); continue; }
      throw e;
    }
  }
}
```

alex: CI build passed on my branch. deploy-bot created a preview: https://deploy-previews.redwood.ai/1763801234. please skim the rendered docs for phrasing issues.

kevin: approving content with pricing placeholders (TBC). once finance confirms i'll update and ping.

maria: one tiny nit left: the header names in the examples should match the runtime exact case we send (we use X-RateLimit-Limit etc.). changed examples to reflect that.

docs-bot: lint OK after fixes  3 warnings (length, example clarity).

sam: coordinated with support on a short email template explaining the new quota semantics; leaving it in the PR as a draft.

alex: planning to merge tomorrow 09:30 PT if finance flips pricing. marking this thread for final check in the morning. thanks all. :thumbsup:
